observations: Original UNF uses XMLCanonicalizingWriter and DOMCanonicalization. Native full-document control accepts the four legacy algorithms and rejects both Canonical XML 1.1 algorithms. Vendor Canonicalize page omits parameters; arity and lifecycle require further native controls. Completed guarded lifecycle control: Close new/closed and default empty writer return empty string; English aliases work; element includes its attributes and used namespace; XPathResult limits selected nodes; repeated canonicalization and unopened writer reject. Earlier lifecycle timeout is excluded from successful receipts. Isolated arity control: constructors zero arguments, SetString zero or one, Canonicalize two or three; sequential arity controls are retained separately and excluded because lifecycle contaminated them. Default and explicit Undefined use Canonical XML; numeric algorithm rejects; Number, Boolean and String XPathResult reject in the legacy workflow.
